title: portrait
summary: MSUI realizes the photo-booth idea end to end for the main slots: PortraitRenderTarget bakes the live dressed model once per appearance change (dirty-flag driven, with retry), framed by the model's authored portrait camera with a bounds-heuristic fallback (Benilla's exact source ladder), pre-masked to the inscribed circle at bake time, with the reference's TemporaryPortrait-{Sex}-{Race}/-Monster stand-ins while loading. The paper-doll and inspect windows get full-body bakes with live rotation, and the glue booth renders char-select/create through the scene's authored camera 0 + attachment 0, matching glue_booth.rs.

openItems.text: No pet portrait slot: the pet frame has no baked portrait
No NPC-interaction portrait: gossip/quest/merchant/trainer/taxi windows never show the bound creature's face where Benilla bakes an 'npc' slot
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: gossip, quest, merchant, trainer, taxi and bank all feed their bound live NPC through DrawUnitPortraitImage at the window-authored seat.

openItems.text: Party frames bake no live portraits - PartyFrameUiLaw's source enum only offers the TemporaryPortrait circular stand-in or empty, vs Benilla's party1-4 booth slots
